svg.aria-label: Eight threads, t0 to t7, each read their own bit of the root bitmap at the same moment. The five that read 0 are an a and are done. A prefix sum gives every thread the number of 1s before it; t1, t3 and t5 get 0, 1 and 2 and read that slot of the b or c bitmap, so b, c and b land at once.
svg.text: 1 thread t reads bit t of the root, all at the same moment
2 a 0 means a, so five threads are done right away
3 every thread counts the 1s before it, in one prefix sum
4 that count is the thread's slot in the b or c bitmap
5 no thread waited for another, a b a c a b a a
count the 1s before you, and every thread finds its slot at once
